summary: A popover anchored below-start of a button that holds a text field with Cancel and Save buttons.
use: Inline editing of a single value, such as renaming a label, without opening a modal.
spec: `<TextField label="Label name" placeholder="e.g. Priority" />` inside `<Stack gap="3">`
`<Flex gap="2" justify="end">` holds `<Button size="sm" variant="ghost">Cancel</Button>` and `<Button size="sm" variant="filled">Save</Button>`
